title: preview placeholder honesty during gpu open

commit.merge_subject: merge: preview placeholder honesty during gpu open

description:
Owner finding 2026-11-14: a fresh 4096x3072 (12MP) clip's editor
showed 'No preview yet — device pass pending' with a spinner DURING
the first-frame preparation window (the GPU session open — probe +
parity + open — plus the first develop, seconds-class on 12MP),
which reads as broken. The placeholder must read as preparing.

EditorPreviewLogic.stateOf gains the GPU-open window as a first-class
input (gpuPreparing: Boolean = false — true from the session-open
request until its first frame or its fallback verdict) and a new
PREPARING state when gpuPreparing && !hasFrame. Precedence keeps the
existing states byte-identical in behavior: RENDERING (CPU in
flight) still wins, a stale frame still shows (FRAME), a real render
failure still shows its error (FAILED); PREPARING slots in only
above IDLE.

The flag's lifecycle in ClipEditorScreen: armed after every early
return guard of the GPU sess
changed: fix: preview placeholder honesty during gpu open
